facts.fact: Hespress reports Morocco's draft organic law on the Chamber of Representatives would penalise election-day campaign posts made through AI tools and AI-generated deepfakes or altered documents, with two to five years' prison for spreading false or altered content.
facts.system: Draft organic law on the Chamber of Representatives

MAR.note: Nothing on government use of AI.
No AI built in the country stated.
Draft electoral penalties are unused powers; nothing on criticism, cuts or anyone punished.
